ticket.title: Visit Notes workspace should accept a Encounter object for editing
ticket.text:
Visit Notes workspace should accept a Encounter object for editing

The Visit notes workspace is implemented to accept an `Encounter` object on edit mode. However, it actually uses the object as if it’s of type `MappedEncounter`, like `encounter.id`, `encounter.rawDatetime`. Typescript didn’t catch this because the `Encounter` type defined in esm-core allows arbitrary fields as `any` type. The workspace is also invoked by passing in a `MappedEncounter` object instead of an `Encounter` object, so this does not technically cause any user-facing issues. However, we should still fix this, as we recently made the visit notes workspace “exported” to be used in the service queues app, thus we are leaking a non-standard abstraction type to other apps.

understanding.intent: Refactor the Visit Notes workspace to accept a standard Encounter object instead of MappedEncounter in edit mode.

criteria.text: The Visit Notes workspace accepts an Encounter object when opened in edit mode.
